summary.text: Lindsay Patterson is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 55, which she has represented since November 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Victoria Martz as her opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Lindsay Patterson was born in Brookville, Indiana.

She earned an associate degree in dental hygiene from the University of Cincinnati and a bachelor's degree in business from Indiana University in 2010, and her career experience includes working as a dental hygienist.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she lives with her husband and sons on a family farm in Franklin County.
Patterson first won the seat in the November 2022 general election, succeeding Cindy Meyer Ziemke, after defeating Curtis Ward, Dave Welsh and John Moton in the Republican primary.
She won re-election in 2024 over Democrat Victoria Martz.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her on the House Environmental Affairs, Family, Children and Human Affairs, and Roads and Transportation committees.
